name: xdBot Companion
description: Android64 beta.19 AI pause-menu control and precise start diagnostics; native and device tests pending. XD TOOLS and monitor remain removed.

share-after-save.name: Offer to share saved macros
share-after-save.description: After a new xdBot macro file finishes saving, ask whether to open the native sharing UI. No file is sent automatically.

ai-record-experimental.name: Allow experimental AI via pause-menu control
ai-record-experimental.description: OFF by default. Pause a disposable normal-mode classic level; tap START AI, confirm, then tap RESUME to reset and begin. STOP AI in the pause menu, manual input or restart cancels this attempt without toggling the preference. Explicitly turning the preference OFF cancels AI. Limited local jump-timing heuristic only; xdBot import/replay unverified.
